# GLAD Studio

> Full-service software studio specializing in AI-powered web applications, mobile app development, data engineering, and business automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **MVP Development**: High-velocity v1 creation for startups (4–8 week delivery timeline).
- **Web Application Development**: Scalable SaaS platforms, custom dashboards, and web portals using React, TypeScript, and TanStack.
- **Mobile Development**: Cross-platform Android & iOS applications using Flutter and React Native.
- **AI & Automation**: Custom LLM integrations, conversational AI, automated lead enrichment, and workflow orchestration.
